_about: Structure of a job specification. Every requirement and criterion must trace to the job analysis. Hard requirements are pass/fail facts that can be checked from the resume or the application; everything that needs judgment is a scored criterion.

_evidence_types.resume_keywords: Pass if any 'match_any' phrase appears in the resume. If an 'ambiguous_if_any' phrase appears near it, the result is UNCLEAR and a person decides.
_evidence_types.application_answer: Pass if the application field equals one of 'pass_values'.
_evidence_types.application_field: Numeric field from the application (e.g. an assessment score), mapped to 0-100.
_evidence_types.resume_experience_months: Months of experience in roles whose title or description contains any 'counts_if_any' word, capped at 'cap_months'.
_evidence_types.resume_skills: Count of distinct listed 'skills' found in the resume; 'full_marks_at' distinct skills = 100.
